pr_title: BUG: Fix return of missing values when applying loc to single level of MultiIndex
pr_body:
- [x] closes #27104
- [x] tests added / passed
- [x] passes `black pandas`
- [x] passes `git diff upstream/master -u -- "*.py" | flake8 --diff`
- [x] whatsnew entry

This confused ``-1`` representing missing values in input with the ``-1`` signaling which components to exclude from output.

cc @jreback green


Thanks for merging master

issue_context.title: Partial indexing with list on MultiIndex with missing value includes them despite not being in the list
issue_context.body:
#### Code Sample, a copy-pastable example if possible

```python
In [2]: df = pd.DataFrame({'col':[1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 'ind1':['a','b','c','d',np.nan], 'ind2':[1,2,3,4,5] }).set_index(['ind1', 'ind2'])                                                                                                          

In [3]: df.loc['a']                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
Out[3]: 
      col
ind2     
1       1

In [4]: df.loc[['a']]                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
Out[4]: 
           col
ind1 ind2     
a    1       1
NaN  5       5


```
#### Problem description

``Out[3]`` is correct, ``Out[4]`` is wrong - the ``NaN`` line should not be there.

From #15107.

#### Expected Output

Same as ``Out[3]``.
